c.st: Let’s Build a Compiler (1995)
c.x: I have that one on my shelf.  It's decent, but it doesn't cover anything that the other two don't.  Compared to Engineering a Compiler, the Aho, Sethi, and Ullman book goes into more depth on the theory, and the Appel book has a better breadth of topics.  It's not a bad book by any means, but I'd recommend that if you only have the cash for one book, go for the Appel book.
